candidates.title: Bombay HC stays bail granted to Sachin Waze in Antilia bomb scare case
candidates.excerpt: The Bombay High Court stayed the bail granted to Sachin Waze in the Antilia bomb scare case after the NIA challenged the special court's order. The HC issued notice to Waze and posted the agency's appeal for October 7

candidates.title: October 2 ‘No UPI Day’ Protest Withdrawn After Traders Meet Nirmala Sitharaman
candidates.excerpt: Leading traders’ bodies have withdrawn their call to observe October 2 as “No UPI Day” following a meeting with Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Wednesday in the national capital.

candidates.title: Opposition to march to EC, demands return to ballot paper
candidates.excerpt: New Delhi: The INDIA bloc on Wednesday, September 30, finalised a joint action plan over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) row, including holding rallies and ‘save democracy marches’, with Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge asserting that all parties agreed that elections should be held through ballot papers instead of EVMs. The opposition grouping made the assertion …

candidates.title: Iran receives US response to proposal aimed at ending war
candidates.excerpt: On the 214th day of the conflict between the United States (US) and Iran, Iranian authorities said on Wednesday, September 30, that they had received Washington’s formal response to Tehran’s proposal aimed at ending the war. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi received the US response through Qatari mediators and presented it to President Masoud Pezeshkian …

candidates.title: Indian sailor among five killed, another injured as Somali forces retake hijacked tanker
candidates.excerpt: Puntland Maritime Police Force says three Pakistanis, one Indian and one Myanmar national were killed before it retook the Palau-flagged tanker MT Honour 25 from pirates

candidates.title: Telangana native Sandy Reddy elected Strathfield Mayor in Australia
candidates.excerpt: Telangana native Sandy Reddy has been unanimously elected Mayor of Strathfield in Australia, becoming the first Indian migrant woman to hold the post. Her election was welcomed by the Telugu community, with BRS leaders congratulating her on the achievement.

candidates.title: Police detain BRS leaders ahead of Revanth Reddy’s Sircilla visit
candidates.excerpt: Police detained several opposition leaders, activists, farmers and auto-driver representatives in Rajanna Sircilla and parts of Karimnagar districts ahead of Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy’s visit. The action came amid apprehensions of protests during his public meeting in Sircilla.

candidates.title: Japan calls on India to fast-track internal process on UNICORN naval radar agreement
candidates.excerpt: The pact for transfer of technology was signed during Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s India visit in July

candidates.title: India criticises Pakistan’s ‘falsehoods’ and ‘deceit’ at UN; warns terrorism will have consequences
candidates.excerpt: India used its Right of Reply after Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif credited U.S. President Donald Trump for a ‘timely intervention’ in the 2025 conflict and raised the Kashmir issue

candidates.title: Wages to welfare board: Telangana gig workers seek immediate implementation of TGPW Act
candidates.excerpt: Telangana Gig and Platform Workers Union founder president Shaik Salauddin said implementing the Gig and Platform Workers Act was an immediate requirement and called for the rules to be framed and a welfare board to be constituted for the workers.
